name: @thetis/exa
description: Web search, page contents, summaries, direct answers, and deep research through the Exa API, as tools for the model.

apiKey.help: The Exa API key; put it in .env as EXA_API_KEY and reference it, since a tool call without one fails.

baseUrl.help: The API root; a proxy goes here.

timeoutMs.help: How long one HTTP request to Exa may take, in milliseconds.

defaults.help: Tool defaults the model can override per call: numResults (8), maxCharacters (no cap) and researchWaitSeconds (240, at most 540).

tools.name: exa_search
tools.description: Search the web with Exa. Returns ranked results with title, URL, date, and by default the passages most relevant to the query. Use it to find current information, sources, papers, companies, or news. Ask for text when you need whole pages.

query.description: What to search for. A natural-language description of the page you want works best, for example: 'blog post explaining how prompt caching works in Anthropic's API'

type.description: auto (default) picks the mode. instant and fast are cheaper and quicker. deep runs several searches and is slower and dearer.

category.description: Restrict to one kind of page

includeDomains.description: Only results from these domains, for example ["arxiv.org"]

startPublishedDate.description: Only pages published on or after this ISO 8601 date, for example 2026-01-01

endPublishedDate.description: Only pages published on or before this ISO 8601 date

includeText.description: Only pages whose text contains this phrase (one entry, up to 5 words)

excludeText.description: Only pages whose text does not contain this phrase

userLocation.description: Two-letter country code that localizes the results, for example US

text.description: Return the page text of each result. A number caps the text at that many characters. Costs more than highlights.

highlights.description: Return the passages most relevant to the query. Cheap and usually enough. On by default when no other content is asked for.

summary.description: Return a short generated summary of each page. A string focuses the summary on that question.

maxCharacters.description: Cap for text fields, in characters

maxAgeHours.description: Re-crawl a page when the cached copy is older than this many hours. 0 always re-crawls.

tools.name: exa_contents
tools.description: Fetch the contents of one or more web pages by URL through Exa: clean page text, relevant highlights, a summary, or the links on the page. Use it to read a page you already know the address of.

urls.description: The pages to fetch, up to 100

text.description: Return the page text of each page. A number caps the text at that many characters. Costs more than highlights.

highlights.description: Return the passages most relevant to the query. Cheap and usually enough. On by default when no other content is asked for.

summary.description: Return a short generated summary of each page. A string focuses the summary on that question.

maxCharacters.description: Cap for text fields, in characters

highlightsQuery.description: Select highlights about this question instead of the whole page

summaryQuery.description: What the summary should focus on

maxAgeHours.description: Re-crawl when the cached copy is older than this many hours. 0 forces a fresh crawl.

livecrawlTimeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for a live crawl, up to 90000

subpages.description: Also fetch up to this many linked pages of the same site

subpageTarget.description: Words that pick the subpages to fetch, for example ["pricing", "docs"]

links.description: Return up to this many links found on each page

tools.name: exa_summarize
tools.description: Summarize one or more web pages with Exa. Returns a short summary per URL, optionally focused on a question or shaped by a JSON schema. Cheaper than reading whole pages.

query.description: What the summary should answer or focus on. Default: purpose, main points, key facts.

schema.description: A JSON schema. The summary then comes back as JSON in that shape.

maxAgeHours.description: Re-crawl when the cached copy is older than this many hours

tools.name: exa_find_similar
tools.description: Find web pages similar to a given URL through Exa. Use it to find competitors, related papers, or more of the same kind of page.

url.description: The page to find neighbours of

excludeSourceDomain.description: Leave out pages from the same domain as the URL

includeDomains.description: Only results from these domains, for example ["arxiv.org"]

startPublishedDate.description: Only pages published on or after this ISO 8601 date, for example 2026-01-01

endPublishedDate.description: Only pages published on or before this ISO 8601 date

text.description: Return the page text of each result. A number caps the text at that many characters. Costs more than highlights.

highlights.description: Return the passages most relevant to the query. Cheap and usually enough. On by default when no other content is asked for.

summary.description: Return a short generated summary of each page. A string focuses the summary on that question.

maxCharacters.description: Cap for text fields, in characters

tools.name: exa_answer
tools.description: Ask Exa a question and get a direct answer grounded in web search, with the sources it used. Good for factual questions and quick lookups. For a long report use exa_research.

text.description: Include the full text of each source

model.description: exa (default) is fast; exa-pro does more searches; exa-fast is quickest.

systemPrompt.description: Instructions on the shape or tone of the answer

outputSchema.description: A JSON schema. The answer then comes back as JSON in that shape.

maxCharacters.description: Cap for source text, in characters

tools.name: exa_research
tools.description: Start a multi-step research run on Exa: it searches, reads, and writes a cited report on an open question. Slow (often minutes) and the dearest Exa call. By default it waits for the result; set wait to false to get an id and poll with exa_research_get.

systemPrompt.description: Guidance on the output: format, length, audience

effort.description: How much work to do. Default auto.

outputSchema.description: A JSON schema for a structured result

previousRunId.description: A completed run to continue from

maxCostDollars.description: Stop the run when its cost reaches this many dollars. At least 1. Default 5.

wait.description: Wait for the run to finish. Default true.

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait at most. Default 240, at most 540.

tools.name: exa_research_get
tools.description: Get the status and result of an Exa research run by id.

tools.name: exa_research_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a running Exa research run by id.

tools.name: exa_research_list
tools.description: List recent Exa research runs, newest first.

limit.description: Runs per page, up to 100. Default 20.

cursor.description: The cursor from a previous page

tools.name: exa_request
tools.description: Call any Exa API endpoint directly with the configured key, for example the Websets API (/websets/v0/websets) or an endpoint these tools do not cover. Returns the JSON reply. Read https://exa.ai/docs/reference for the paths and bodies.

path.description: The path under https://api.exa.ai, starting with /, for example /websets/v0/websets

method.description: Default GET, or POST when a body is given
